messages:
harper (CloudOps): Hi team — POC stuck on SSO verification. We added `_rw-verify.prodcorp.com TXT "rw=7x2b"` but verifier times out. Any suggestions?

maya (Sales): Sorry for the blocker. Oscar from SE will triage. Which DNS provider?

harper (CloudOps): Using ManagedDNS, TTL 120, added to subdomain. dig from our datacenter shows the TXT but public resolvers differ.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Sounds like resolver divergence. Two options: 1) add the token at the apex and set TTL=30, or 2) provide signed SAML metadata from your IdP and we can accept that for the POC (rahul can enable temporary override).

rahul (Infra): I can enable signed-metadata validation for a 7-day window. Must include entityID, cert fingerprint, and an assertion of control. Longer term needs legal signoff.

harper (CloudOps): We'll try apex TXT first. Also question on SCIM: we need group->RBAC mapping for `eng-*` -> developer and `sec` -> admin. Support attribute-based matching?

oscar (Solutions Eng): Yes. We map via regex. Example: group_map: [{"match":"^eng-.*$","role":"developer"},{"match":"^sec$","role":"admin"}]. We support PATCH and incremental ops.

nora (Security): Security asks: NameID format? audit retention? transport requirements?

harper (CloudOps): Compliance needs persistent NameID and 13 months audit retention. SCIM over TLS is fine.

nora (Security): Hosted default is 90d, enterprise can export logs to customer S3 for 13mo retention. We'll need DPA addendum for that.

liam (Acct Exec): Commercially, we can offer a 30-day Dedicated trial to run failover tests. I'll attach pricing details once SE confirms throughput needs.

oscar (Solutions Eng): For failover, we support secondary IdPs and cached sessions. We'll demo primary->secondary routing and session cache fallback. Also can bump SCIM rate limits for the POC (14 days). Provide expected group sizes.

harper (CloudOps): Group sizes: eng ~1.2k, sec ~60. Daily churn low.

legalbot: Auto-note — DPA amendment required for >90 day retention and cross-border exports. Maya, preparing addendum.

maya (Sales): Next steps: 1) Harper to add apex TXT or upload signed metadata, 2) Harper to confirm signer for DPA, 3) SE to queue rate-limit bump and prepare SAML metadata template, 4) AE/legal to circulate DPA addendum. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow.

deploy-bot: POC tenant provisioned: poc-prodcorp-211900: endpoint and SCIM registered.

harper (CloudOps): Thanks all — will update after TXT or metadata upload.
